description: Native iOS voice assistant client. Forked from VoxClaw — strip TTS/teleprompter, add LiveKit bidirectional voice with background audio persistence. Connects to existing always_on_voice.py server.
techStack: Swift 6.2, SwiftUI, iOS 17+, LiveKit Swift SDK 2.12+, Swift Package Manager

userStories.title: Strip VoxClaw to Clean iOS Shell
userStories.description: Remove all VoxClaw-specific code (TTS services, teleprompter, HTTP listener, overlay, CLI, macOS target) to create a clean iOS app shell.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove Sources/VoxClawCore/Audio/ (TTSService, ElevenLabsTTSService, FallbackSpeechEngine, AppleSpeechEngine, AudioPlayer and any other TTS files)
Remove Sources/VoxClawCore/Reading/ (ReadingSession, WordTimingEstimator, SpeechAligner and related files)
Remove Sources/VoxClawCore/Network/NetworkListener.swift, NetworkSession.swift, HTTPRequestParser.swift
Remove Sources/VoxClawCore/Panel/ (FloatingPanel, PanelController — macOS overlay)
Remove Sources/VoxClawCore/Input/CLIParser.swift and ModeDetector.swift
Remove Sources/VoxClawCore/Input/InputResolver.swift if it exists
Keep PeerBrowser.swift (Bonjour discovery — will adapt later)
Keep KeychainHelper.swift (will repurpose)
Keep SettingsManager.swift (will modify in later story)
Keep AppState.swift (will rewrite in later story)
Keep Log.swift (logging utility)
Remove macOS-specific views and code paths
Update Package.swift — remove macOS platform, keep iOS 17+ only
Remove VoxClawCore executable target, keep library target
Update VoxClawIOS app to import from cleaned library
Remove all VoxClaw tests that test removed functionality
App builds for iOS simulator without errors
App launches on simulator (blank/minimal screen is fine)

userStories.title: LiveKit SDK + Room Connection
userStories.description: Add LiveKit Swift SDK and implement room connection via token endpoint. The app should connect to the existing Loom server's LiveKit room and publish/subscribe audio.
acceptanceCriteria: Add LiveKit client-sdk-swift (>= 2.12.1) as Swift Package dependency
Create Managers/RoomManager.swift — @Observable class, @MainActor isolated
RoomManager has ConnectionState enum: .disconnected, .connecting, .connected, .reconnecting(attempt:), .failed(Error)
Create Managers/ServerAPI.swift with fetchToken(deviceId:) async throws -> TokenResponse
Create Models/TokenResponse.swift — Codable struct for { token, url, room, version }
Create Models/HealthResponse.swift — Codable struct for /health response
Device ID is a stable UUID stored in @AppStorage("deviceId"), generated on first launch
On connect: fetch token from GET /token?deviceId=<uuid>, then room.connect(url:token:)
Configure RoomOptions with AudioCaptureOptions(echoCancellation: true, noiseSuppression: true, autoGainControl: true)
Configure AudioPublishOptions(dtx: true) for bandwidth savings
Implement RoomDelegate for connection state changes (didUpdateConnectionState)
Implement RoomDelegate for track subscription (didSubscribeTrack)
Auto-publish microphone on connect: room.localParticipant.setMicrophone(enabled: true)
Server URL defaults to https://erics-macbook-pro.tail893ab1.ts.net:8089 (stored in @AppStorage)
LiveKit URL comes from token response, not hardcoded
Basic UI showing connection state (connected/disconnected text is fine)
App compiles and builds for iOS

userStories.title: Audio Session + Background Persistence
userStories.description: Configure AVAudioSession and background modes so the voice connection survives backgrounding, interruptions, and audio route changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Info.plist: UIBackgroundModes includes 'audio' and 'voip'
Info.plist: NSMicrophoneUsageDescription set to meaningful string
Create Managers/AudioSessionManager.swift
Let LiveKit SDK manage AVAudioSession automatically (isAutomaticConfigurationEnabled = true)
Enable setRecordingAlwaysPreparedMode(true) for instant mic availability
Set duckingLevel = .min to minimize ducking other audio
Set mic mute mode to .voiceProcessing (fast mute, no audio engine restart)
Handle AVAudioSession.interruptionNotification — began and ended cases
On interruption ended with .shouldResume: reactivate audio session
Handle AVAudioSession.routeChangeNotification for headphone/BT changes
Create Utilities/BackgroundKeepAlive.swift — play inaudible tone every 90s if no audio activity (insurance against iOS killing background audio)
Audio session configured before LiveKit room.connect() is called

userStories.title: Reconnection State Machine
userStories.description: Implement automatic reconnection with exponential backoff and network transition handling so the app recovers from drops without user intervention.
acceptanceCriteria: Create ReconnectPolicy struct: initialDelay 0.5s, maxDelay 30s, backoffMultiplier 1.5, maxAttempts 20, jitter ±30%
Create Utilities/NetworkMonitor.swift wrapping NWPathMonitor
On disconnect from RoomDelegate: start reconnect loop with exponential backoff
Each reconnect attempt: check /health endpoint first, only attempt room.connect if server is up
On NWPathMonitor path change (WiFi↔cell): immediately attempt reconnect, reset backoff counter
Fetch fresh token on each reconnect attempt (token may have expired)
Cancel reconnect loop on successful connect
After max attempts exhausted: set connectionState to .failed
LiveKit SDK built-in reconnect handles ICE restarts; our loop is the fallback layer on top
RoomManager.startReconnectLoop() uses structured concurrency (Task, cancellation)
Reconnect task is properly cancelled when room connects or app disconnects intentionally

userStories.title: Orb View + Main Voice UI
userStories.description: Create the main voice-first UI with an animated orb that communicates connection state and speaking activity visually.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Views/VoiceView.swift — main screen with orb centered, settings gear top-right, status bottom bar
Create Views/OrbView.swift — animated orb using TimelineView + Canvas

Orb states with distinct colors: idle (slate gray), listening (slate gray subtle pulse), thinking (soft blue), speaking (warm amber, audio-reactive), disconnected (red static), muted (dimmed + slash overlay)
Orb breathing animation: slow sine wave modulating radius (~1.5 Hz cycle)
Orb audio reactivity when speaking: map RemoteTrackPublication.audioLevel to radius delta
Detect Loom speaking via remote participant's audio track level > threshold
'Loom' label below orb
Tap orb toggles mute with haptic feedback (UIImpactFeedbackGenerator, medium)
Bottom bar: mute button + connection status dot (green connected, yellow reconnecting, red disconnected)
Dark mode only — dark background, no light mode support needed
SF Symbols for all icons, system typography (SF Pro)
VoiceView receives RoomManager as @EnvironmentObject or @Environment
App entry point (LoomVoiceApp.swift or equivalent) creates RoomManager and injects into view hierarchy

userStories.title: Settings Screen
userStories.description: Create a settings screen for server URL configuration and connection status display.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Views/SettingsView.swift with NavigationStack
CONNECTION section: server URL (editable TextField), connection status indicator, room name, latency if available
AUDIO section: push-to-talk toggle (@AppStorage), always-on mic toggle
ABOUT section: app version (from bundle), server version (from /health response)
Settings gear icon on VoiceView top-right navigates to SettingsView
Server URL changes trigger disconnect and reconnect with new URL
Default server URL pre-filled: https://erics-macbook-pro.tail893ab1.ts.net:8089
Rewrite SettingsManager.swift to hold Loom Voice settings instead of VoxClaw TTS settings
Settings persist via @AppStorage / UserDefaults

userStories.title: Mute + Push-to-Talk
userStories.description: Implement microphone mute toggle and optional push-to-talk mode for noisy environments.
acceptanceCriteria: Mute toggle calls room.localParticipant.setMicrophone(enabled:)
Mute state reflected in orb (dimmed appearance + slash overlay)
Haptic feedback on mute toggle (medium impact)
Push-to-talk mode: long-press orb to unmute, release to re-mute
Push-to-talk preference stored in @AppStorage
When push-to-talk enabled, mic starts muted, subtle 'hold to talk' hint shown
Normal mode (always-on mic) is the default

userStories.title: Local Disconnect Notifications
userStories.description: Fire local notifications when connection drops so the user knows to reopen the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Managers/NotificationManager.swift
Request UNUserNotificationCenter authorization on first launch
Fire local notification when reconnect fails after 3 attempts
Notification: title 'Loom Voice', body 'Connection lost. Tap to reconnect.'
Tapping notification opens the app
Rate limit: max 1 disconnect notification per 5 minutes
Clear pending notifications when app successfully reconnects

userStories.title: Adapt Bonjour Discovery
userStories.description: Adapt VoxClaw's PeerBrowser to discover Loom Voice servers on the local network.
acceptanceCriteria: Modify PeerBrowser.swift to browse for _loom-voice._tcp instead of _voxclaw._tcp
Remove OpenClaw discovery (_openclaw._tcp) from PeerBrowser
Update PeerApp enum to .loomVoice instead of .voxclaw
When a Loom server is discovered on LAN, surface it in Settings as a connection option
If no saved URL and Bonjour finds a server, auto-connect to it
Bonjour is secondary to saved URL (don't override user manual config)
Info.plist: NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription and NSBonjourServices set for _loom-voice._tcp
